findings.title: Monitor context sends raw config, not the display copy
findings.body: get_monitor_environment_context copies monitor.config and, when schedule_type is present, replaces it with get_schedule_type_display() on that copy. The returned context then sets "config" to monitor_environment.monitor.config, the original dict, so the transformed copy is discarded. Issue occurrences therefore still carry the numeric schedule_type instead of the human-readable schedule type the code just computed, and any later mutation of the returned config mutates the in-memory model config.
